title: Miso-Glazed Turkey Breast with Greens
description: Miso-glazed turkey breast sliced thin over wilted spinach and sesame-ginger cauliflower rice.
steps: Mix the miso, honey, soy sauce, oil, garlic and ginger into a glaze.
Sear the turkey, brush with the glaze, then finish in the oven until cooked through.
Steam the cauliflower rice and wilt the spinach, then plate with the sliced turkey.
notes: Miso's live cultures support digestion, and slicing the turkey thin keeps every bite tender.
